payload.verify_command: python3 -c "import json;from pathlib import Path;d=json.loads(Path('contract/project-design.json').read_text());types={t['name']:t for t in d['records']};a=types['acceptance'];assert 'test_ids' in a['payload'] and 'oracle_hashes' in a['payload'];assert 'test_ids' in a.get('optional_payload',[]) and 'oracle_hashes' in a.get('optional_payload',[]);am=types['oracle-amendment'];assert set(am['required_sections'])>={'Reason','Change'};assert 'status' in am['payload'];assert set(am.get('payload_enum',{}).get('status',[]))>={'requested','approved','rejected'}"
